channel.title: Dr. Bijaya Bikram Samal: News
channel.description: Papers, patents, talks and updates from Dr. Bijaya Bikram Samal, 4D printing researcher, IIT Kanpur.

item.title: Tutor for TA111 at IIT Kanpur
item.description: Taking tutorials for the TA111 course this semester at IIT Kanpur, after serving as tutor for Engineering Graphics (TA-101) earlier in 2026.

item.title: JST Sakura Science Exchange Fellowship, Japan
item.description: Research visit to Prof. Hiroaki Wagatsuma's lab at Kyushu Institute of Technology on multimodal human–machine interaction (neural signals, eye tracking, motion capture), plus 4D printing discussions with Prof. Fujio Tsumori, Kyushu University.

item.title: Wave isolation in shells and metasurfaces (Thin-Walled Structures, Q1)
item.description: Peridynamics modelling and experiments on wave isolation in 3D-printed shells and mechanical metasurfaces, published in Thin-Walled Structures (IF 6.6).

item.title: Nitinol SMA actuators with bead-on-fiber coating (Sensors & Actuators A, Q1)
item.description: Thermal-plume and thermo-mechanical characteristics of coated Nitinol shape memory alloy actuators, published in Sensors and Actuators A: Physical.

item.title: Two Indian patents filed
item.description: Filed: a compressed-air propelled Cargo Hyperloop system with rail-wheel configuration (202611001298) and an additively manufactured Bouligand-auxetic metamaterial (202611014037).

item.title: MWCNT-coated nickel foam for EMI shielding (Nanotechnology Reviews, Q1)
item.description: Lightweight nickel foam coated with multi-walled carbon nanotubes for electromagnetic interference shielding, with multiphysics evaluation.

item.title: 3D/4D printing workshop at RAMEA 2026, NERIST
item.description: Speaker at the two-day RAMEA 2026 pre-conference workshop "3D/4D Printing: From Fundamentals to Functional Structures & Innovation Pathways" at NERIST, Arunachal Pradesh, with speakers from IIT Kanpur, IIT Bombay and IIT Guwahati.

item.title: Chapter accepted in Elsevier's Handbook of 4D Printing
item.description: "4D Printing of Shape Memory Polymers by Material Extrusion" accepted for the Elsevier Handbook of 4D Printing of Shape Memory Polymers.

item.title: Presenting 4D printing at FEMS EUROMAT 2023, Frankfurt
item.description: Presented 4D printing of shape memory polymers at the 17th European Congress on Advanced Materials and Processes, Goethe University Frankfurt, the only presenter from India in the 4D printing symposium.

item.title: Symposium organizer, MSE 2026, TU Darmstadt
item.description: Organized symposium P06 "Additive Manufacturing Technologies and Materials" at the Materials Science and Engineering Congress (MSE 2026), TU Darmstadt, Germany, as he did at MSE 2024.

item.title: Sustainable 3D printing of PHA (National Academy Science Letters)
item.description: Material characterization, printability and parametric optimization of biodegradable polyhydroxyalkanoates for dimensional accuracy.

item.title: Bioinspired Bouligand-auxetic metastructures (SSRN)
item.description: Preprint on bioinspired Bouligand-auxetic metastructures with orientation-dependent multifunctional performance.

item.title: Institute Postdoctoral Fellow, IIT Kanpur
item.description: Joined IIT Kanpur as Institute Postdoctoral Fellow, working on 4D-printed bioinspired Bouligand-auxetic metamaterials and multi-material freeform additive manufacturing.

item.title: FDP talk on 4D printing & sustainability, SIT Tumakuru
item.description: Faculty Development Program lecture on "4D Printing & Sustainability" at Siddaganga Institute of Technology, Tumakuru.

item.title: Wiley book "4D Printing Technology" published
item.description: Lead editor of 4D Printing Technology: Principles, Materials and Application (Wiley-Scrivener), with six chapters authored by Dr. Samal.

item.title: Biodegradability of 3D-printed PHB (Science of the Total Environment, Q1)
item.description: Anaerobic biodegradability of PHB filament and 3D-printed sheets measured with the biochemical methane potential test (IF 8.0).

item.title: Member (MIE), Institution of Engineers (India)
item.description: Enrolled as a Member of the Institution of Engineers (India), Mechanical Engineering Division, following AMIE membership and Chartered Engineer certification.

item.title: 4D printing research as a Saral AI explainer video
item.description: His Smart Materials and Structures paper on 4D printing of shape memory polymers was turned into a short Saral AI video to make the research easier to follow.

item.title: Ph.D. in Four-Dimensional Printing, IIT Kharagpur
item.description: Ph.D. awarded for the thesis "Four-Dimensional Printing: Shape Programming, Material Characterization, and Parametric Optimization".
